description: Source code for a custom web component 'todo-list' that manages a list of todo items, including adding, removing, toggling, and updating item views and styles.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: A custom HTML element extending HTMLElement to manage a list of todo items with functionalities like add, remove, toggle, and update views.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Creates a new TodoItem element with given entry data and appends it to the list.

methods.name: addItems
methods.description: Adds multiple todo items to the list.

methods.name: removeCompletedItems
methods.description: Removes all todo items marked as completed.

methods.name: toggleItems
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of all items based on the 'completed' parameter.

methods.name: updateStyles
methods.description: Updates the display style of the todo list based on total items.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the display of individual todo items based on current route (all, active, completed).

methods.name: updateElements
methods.description: Updates the list of elements based on action type (route change, toggle, add, remove).

methods.name: updateRoute
methods.description: Sets the current route and updates the view accordingly.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Handles changes to observed attributes, updating styles if necessary.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the element is connected to the DOM; updates styles.
